reviewSamples.author: Xavier Muniz
reviewSamples.text: Awesome service! I was stuck on the beach and Ray came to the rescue! Any other mechanic would’ve made me tow the car. I ain’t got the money or time for that.

reviewSamples.author: Eddie Perez
reviewSamples.text: Great Proffesional Service!! Ray quickly identified the issue with my car and repaired it. I definitely recommend this Mechanic.

reviewSamples.author: Oliver Chizz
reviewSamples.text: Hello folks, I just had Ray Ray come fix my car and he did a great Job, car running like I never had a problem, plus he stands by his work..any issues he will come and take care of it...he's mobile and will come to you...check him out ppl

reviewSamples.author: Dasia Thiena
reviewSamples.text: Quick and sufficient service I have done business with Ray on 3 different occasions and he hasn’t disappointed! Very professional and trustworthy. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a reliable mechanic.
